comment: Series the politics shadow recorder (scripts/record_politics.py) reads. Chosen from the Nov 11, 2026 politics census: series that settled within 14 days (the hold cap was 14 days; the owner moved it to 30 days on Nov 11, 2026, so cap_days is 30 and this list is re-ranked under 30 days by a later reviewed edit). Editing this list is a reviewed change; the script refuses more than max_series and a name that is not an uppercase Kalshi series ticker. later_only is only a note of series left out on purpose because they settle past 14 days; nothing reads it for recording.
